title: CommitmentExtractorInput
description: Input for commitment extraction from a meeting transcript. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad extraction) or transcript + context (targeted extraction with participant directory, focus person, and meeting metadata). All optional fields improve extraction quality when provided.

transcript.description: Full meeting transcript text. Must include enough content for meaningful commitment extraction (minimum 80 characters). Speaker-attributed transcripts produce higher-confidence output.

meeting_title.description: Title or subject of the meeting. Helps contextualize commitments. Example: 'APAC Expansion Planning — Week 12'.

meeting_datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime of when the meeting occurred. Used to normalize relative due dates (e.g. 'next Friday') into absolute dates.

default_timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for interpreting relative dates when no explicit timezone is given. Example: 'America/Los_Angeles', 'Asia/Tokyo'.

participant_directory.description: Known participants to seed owner resolution. The extractor will still discover additional owners from the transcript.

name.description: Full name of the participant as they appear in the transcript.

role.description: Job title or organizational role. Example: 'VP Engineering', 'Product Lead'.

team.description: Team, department, or business unit. Example: 'Platform', 'Product', 'Finance'.

focus_person.description: Filter or highlight commitments relevant to a specific person. When set, the output prioritizes commitments owned by or dependent on this person.

extraction_mode.description: Controls extraction sensitivity. 'strict' = only explicit, unambiguous commitments with clear owners. 'balanced' = explicit commitments plus high-confidence implied ones. 'inclusive' = all potential commitments including tentative and implied, may include UNKNOWN owners.

include_non_actionable.description: When true, includes non-actionable items such as decisions, observations, and contextual notes alongside actionable commitments.
